description: The cold–humid–calm regime should remain screened out because block-level association did not survive an event-level temporal-independence requirement.
mechanistic_interpretations: A persistent environmental state may create many correlated observations that look like repeated evidence while representing only a small number of independent episodes.
alternative_explanations: Serial dependence may inflate apparent support within long-lived regimes.
The regime label may pool heterogeneous episodes whose RF behavior differs across time.
Block-level enrichment may arise from repeated sampling of the same episode rather than reproducible event-level coupling.
falsification_tests: event_refractory_independence: rebuild support from independent regime episodes separated by a prespecified refractory interval.
blocked_temporal_replication: require event-level direction to remain stable across contiguous temporal folds.
same_clock_matched_control: compare independent regime episodes with temporally matched non-event controls.
uncertainties: The failed gate leaves open whether any narrower, independently defined regime component has reproducible RF relevance.
